question: Can one bounded checker consume the delivered golden-ratio resource set, distinguish the four receipt kinds the atlas asks for, independently re-derive its exact identities in a different encoding, and refuse its eight listed corrections?
level: Documentary resource integrity plus external exact arithmetic; no stable semantic operation, no native witness, no Rust authority
objects: staged resource set: atlas, delivery container, external checker and record, illustration source and rendering, delivery digest record, captured source PDF, seven plates
K = Q[u]/(u^2-u-1) with the real embedding 1 < u < 2, encoded as rational pairs (p,q) for (p+q*sqrt(5))/2; Z[phi] is the matching-parity integer subset
Fibonacci and Lucas sequences, convergent brackets, the matrix M=[[1,1],[1,0]] and its powers
the affine word abbbaBAAB, its parameter controls and the figure-eight arithmetic parameter t=phi^2
the HNN affine realization u:x->x+1, v:x->x+phi, t:x->phi^-2 x and its commuting shadow
rectangle R0=[0,phi]x[0,1] under S(x,y)=(phi-y/phi, x/phi), nested images, residual area and diameter
twelve icosahedron vertices, their 66 pairwise squared distances, edge graph and triangular faces
the A->AB, B->A substitution, and the golden-section interval contraction with and without reuse

types.exact_field: rational coefficient pair (p,q) meaning (p+q*sqrt(5))/2; conjugation is q -> -q; norm is (p^2-5q^2)/4; sign uses rational squares; zero has no inverse. Every element of Q(sqrt 5) is representable this way; the integer ring Z[phi] is the subset with integer coefficients of matching parity and is tested separately, so integer-pair wording does not describe the field.
types.rationals: fractions.Fraction for convergent brackets, interval widths and search traces
types.receipts: four labelled kinds, each carrying the twelve fields declared by the atlas: question_id, object_type, arithmetic_domain, embedding, expression_or_word, evaluation_order, frame, assumptions, fuel_used, claim_scope, witness, residual
types.resources: staged bytes with SHA256 and byte counts from adva-library/golden-ratio/index.json
types.plates: structure only: media type and pixel dimensions; content is not read

quantifiers: All 15 staged artifacts against their recorded digests and byte counts
All five delivered SHA256.json claims and all six delivery-container members against the staged copies
All 310 recorded check names of the delivered external checker, replayed once in a bounded child process
The Fibonacci power and Cassini identities for every 1 <= n <= 24, and the convergent bracket for every 1 <= n <= 24
Every unordered pair among the twelve icosahedron vertices, 66 squared distances
Every one of the eight atlas corrections as a refusal control
Both search objectives for exactly 12 contraction steps, with and without observation reuse
No unbounded search, no random sampling, no transcendental evaluation
The near-integer residual bound 0 < phi^(-n) < 1/2 is checked for 2 <= n <= 24; it fails at n = 1, and the guard is exercised rather than assumed.

The translation component of the affine word is a Laurent polynomial: equal counts of a and A restore multiplier one but do not in general remove negative powers, so the nine-letter word is checked to have none and a two-letter control is checked to have one.
assumptions: The delivered atlas, checker, record, plates and PDF are inputs supplied by the direction; the delivered Python checker is an external oracle, not the Rust semantic kernel
A plate or a captured PDF is a source object or illustration and never a witness for an arithmetic or geometric claim
Digests record byte integrity only; they are not authentication, semantic identity or proof
The four receipt kinds are labels over one checker and do not by themselves establish a general receipt calculus

The integer-pair encoding and the delivered rational-pair encoding are two representations of one field; agreement between them is evidence for these finite instances, not a general translation theorem
protected: No native word, Rust type, IR version, Lisp builtin or stable API is added or changed
No contraction, memoization or CSE is authorized by exact value equality
The Pascal-rooted geometry growth obligation stays Open; admitted geometry successors stay at zero
The delivered resource directory is left untouched; staged copies are byte-identical
No transcendental evaluator, no float acceptance path and no unbounded loop is introduced
acceptance: Every staged artifact matches its recorded sha256 and byte count; the delivered digest claims and all container members agree with the staged copies
The PDF probe recovers the title, the creation date, the article revision identifier cited by the atlas and a well-formed trailer
The delivered checker replays with identical status, identical check count and an identical check-name list; timing and platform fields are excluded rather than compared

The independent integer-pair derivations pass for the field laws, Fibonacci powers, Cassini, convergent brackets, matrix powers, the word residual and its two controls, the HNN relations and their commuting shadow, rectangle images, coverage and residual, the fixed point, icosahedral incidence, the two hyperbolic cosh values, the substitution counts and the bounded search traces
All eight atlas corrections are refused by an executable control
Four receipt kinds are emitted with all twelve declared fields, and each relabeling refusal holds
The three golden rectangle boundaries are pairwise disjoint while their filled sets share an interior point, and the translated-copy and nearby-copy controls behave as declared.
The successor contract supersedes the frozen version by digest, and the retained receiving review is pinned by digest.
The PDF title and creation date are parsed from the staged bytes at run time, not copied from declared metadata.
The declared arithmetic bounds behave as stated: a fractional coefficient is representable and outside the integer ring, and the near-integer bound fails at n = 1.
Both installed and refused resource limits are recorded, and neither is reported as enforced unless it was installed.
The golden triangle subdivides into one copy at scale 1/phi and one gnomon, with the tile shapes, the self-similarity and the Heron area ratios checked exactly.

The dual dodecahedron has twenty equal-radius vertices at the icosahedron's inradius, twelve regular pentagon faces, the closed-form radius ratio, and an inscribed cube whose edges are pentagon diagonals rather than dodecahedron edges.
Every pair of golden rectangle boundaries has linking number zero in both directions, at least one direction showing cancelling crossings, and a control ring threaded once is counted as linked.
The inscribed cube's dual octahedron has six equal-radius vertices, twelve edges, eight faces, and no octahedron has all six vertices among the twelve icosahedron vertices.
For Fibonacci rotation sizes the golden angle's gaps take exactly two lengths in ratio phi with consecutive Fibonacci counts, and equal latitude steps give equal band areas.

The thick and thin rhombi have the stated angles, neither has the golden rhombus's diagonal ratio while the golden rhombus does, and the inflation matrix has characteristic polynomial t^2 - 3t + 1 with counts following consecutive Fibonacci numbers.
unknown: Any budget, bound, digest or replay failure is reported as Unknown or Invalid and never promoted to partial acceptance
replay: python3 -S experiments/golden_ratio/calibration.py --output target/golden-ratio-fresh.json (the output path must not exist)

amendments.addition: Exact boundary-disjointness checks for the three mutually perpendicular golden rectangles determined by the twelve icosahedron vertices, with two controls: a translated copy whose boundary must be detected as meeting, and a nearby copy whose crossings fall at the other golden half-extent and must not.
amendments.reason: The atlas lists this configuration as its Borromean candidate. The first execution verified the vertex, edge and face incidence but left the boundary structure unconstructed.
amendments.effect_on_scope: The question, objects, types, protected list, budget and unknown policy are unchanged. The acceptance list gains the boundary obligation below.

amendments.addition: Exact checks for the golden triangle and its gnomon (tile shapes, the base-angle bisector subdivision, self-similarity, Heron area ratios) and for the dual dodecahedron (twenty face centroids, inradius and circumradius closed forms, regular pentagon faces, and an inscribed cube found by exact search whose edges are pentagon diagonals).
amendments.reason: Two rows of the denotation table were marked Not executed: the golden triangle with its gnomon, and the dual polyhedron with its spheres and inscribed solids.
amendments.effect_on_scope: The question, protected list, budget and unknown policy are unchanged. The inscribed octahedron and the Borromean link certificate remain outside this run.

amendments.addition: Exact pairwise linking numbers for the three golden rectangle boundaries, computed in both directions as signed crossings with a spanning disk and controlled by a ring threaded once through a disk; the dual octahedron of the inscribed cube plus an exhaustive search for an octahedron on the twelve icosahedron vertices; and the golden angle's finite rotation gap structure with the equal-area latitude rule.
amendments.reason: Three residuals were named in the record: the Borromean link certificate, the inscribed octahedron, and the sphere-sampling generator.
amendments.effect_on_scope: Disjoint boundaries are now separated from unlinked curves. The Borromean triple linking invariant, Penrose patch acceptance and any optimality of the rotation set remain outside this run.

amendments.addition: Exact checks for the two Penrose prototiles and their inflation, stated with cosine values, squared diagonal ratios and integer counts because the sines of the tile angles lie outside the field.
amendments.reason: The Penrose patch item was the last unexecuted entry of the atlas's own task list.
amendments.effect_on_scope: Only the prototiles and the inflation counts are covered. Matching-rule acceptance, aperiodicity and any full-plane tiling remain outside this run.

supersedes.note: The version-zero contract is retained byte for byte as the frozen task the first executions ran under. This successor states the receiving audit's corrections instead of rewriting it; the run checks this digest so a later edit of the frozen file is a failure rather than a silent reinterpretation.

review.receiver: independent receiving audit; see the document

budget_enforcement.max_staged_bytes: per-artifact and total byte checks inside the run
budget_enforcement.max_output_file_bytes: size check before writing the report
budget_enforcement.cpu_seconds: installed as RLIMIT_CPU by the run where the platform allows; the outcome is recorded
budget_enforcement.address_space_bytes: declared outer bound; the run attempts RLIMIT_AS and records refusal. On this platform the install fails after startup because the current address space already exceeds the bound, so the caller must impose it, as the receiving audit's external wrapper did.
budget_enforcement.note: A recorded outcome is not enforcement; where a limit is not installed the caller owns it.
